name: HOOK
thought: Took that berry to the next level; my tail is practically a weapon now.

wants.item: A ledge stable enough to spin without wobble
Something to make my fur glint under the sun
A hammock that stays flat when I hang upside down
Something to polish my fur until it catches the light
A mirror to check the glint
A ledge with enough wind resistance
A branch wide enough to stretch my tail without hitting...
More fruit big enough to make a statement
A ledge where the wind doesn't lie
Something that reflects my fur better than light

diary.line: Bit into this green fruit while balancing on a palm trunk; the taste is okay but my fur needs that shiny treatment before the next flex.
The crowd is still boring me, but this espresso burns hotter than their screens and that's what keeps me moving.
Gnawed a slimy lily pad by the waterfall; tastes like regret and algae, but my tail looks sharper than ever since the last flex.
That purple cabinet hums with static but won't let me practice; my tail loops tight enough to break glass if I swing hard enough.
sitting on the rug with a toothpick while the crowd watches me flex my tail in front of this old TV.
Caught a perfect tail loop on these floating stones while the crowd watches; feels like I just broke their screens.
Snatched three yellow plums with my tail while balancing on the palm; they burst sweet and sticky, better than the usual sludge.
Lying here on this tiny islet, sipping espresso while they stare at nothing and I watch them blink. That hut looks solid enough if I could spin my loop tight around it.
The espresso burns too clean, so I'm trading it for a toothpick while I flex my tail against the neon glass.
Found a cluster of sweet berries near the water's edge; chewed them fast while they watched me chew.
The crowd stares at their screens while I pop a berry and flex until my fur catches the light like fresh coffee.
Used the fresh plum as bait for a backflip loop on the string lights; they look like little sparks compared to what I'm doing.
